Be it remembered that on the twenty first day of December in the year of our Lord one thousand 
eight hundred and forty seven, Letters of Administration on the Estate of John Durham deceased 
were this day granted to Frances Durham who was sworn and gave bond with Enoch Durham his surety 
in the final sum of three hundred dollars. Warrant of appraisment (unclear) to William Keith and 
William Bishop (unclear) Bond filed 259.
